_README: SKELETON of ~/.claude/settings.json for dead-disk recovery from THIS repo. The GitHub repo backs up Claude-Core only, NOT ~/.claude, so rebuild settings.json from this at recovery time. lean-ctx re-adds its own observe/rewrite/redirect hooks and the Read/Grep/Glob deny on install, so those self-heal and are omitted here. The DeepSeek env block is NOT here: run templates/apply-deepseek-switch.mjs to add it (it holds the real key, which NEVER goes in the repo). Adjust absolute paths to the recovery machine.
model: <your model, e.g. opus[1m]; on DeepSeek the ANTHROPIC_* env from apply-deepseek-switch.mjs drives the model instead>

statusLine._comment: The DeepSeek money meter (balance, today's observed spend, live peak/off-peak state; zero token cost, renders outside the model's context). SUPERSEDES the old 'ccusage statusline' Aug 24 2026: ccusage computes from cache-token accounting the DeepSeek endpoint never returns (lessons/platform-gotchas.md, DeepSeek API), so it had nothing to show here. Re-point the absolute path on a recovery machine. Regression net: templates/global/_meter_test.mjs, MANDATORY after any meter edit.

hooks._comment: lean-ctx adds its own observe (PostToolUse/PreCompact/SessionEnd/SessionStart/Stop/UserPromptSubmit) + rewrite/redirect (PreToolUse) hooks on install; only the CUSTOM session-ritual wiring is preserved here. Re-point the absolute path to the recovery machine's home. The SessionStart matcher is a CATCH-ALL and must stay one: the hook resolves any unrecognised source to compact, and that defence is unreachable if the matcher enumerates today's source names — a renamed or added platform source would simply never invoke the hook (audit Jul 26 2026). Never list sources here.
